provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Existing source metadata remains with the original guide; proper names use the paired game localization dictionary.

stageName.text: D-02 Branch, Floor 1: Information Team Passage

lead.text: Clash against branch and root attacks and use spare actions on the fruit. Destroying fruit applies Fragile across the body. If the fight lasts, stop the branches to prevent the area attack. HP cannot fall below 1 during the first 2 turns.

statNote.text: The Floor 1 encounter in 1-11: Lv. 6, 456 main-body HP. During the first 2 turns, its HP cannot fall below 1 and it cannot die. The HP entry distinguishes main-body and Fruit HP; other entries show Part HP. These stats differ from the Thread Luxcavation and Mirror Dungeon versions.

skillNote.text: All 8 skill entries are listed by the Part that uses them. The right and left Stems' “Pale Stem” skills differ only in their icons. The Roots' attack is also called Vine Spike in the action table, but is listed here as “Root Spike” from the skill table. On Heads Hit and On Hit are distinct conditions.

priorities.0.text: Clash against Stem and Root attacks, and direct spare attacks at the Fruit. Destroying the Fruit grants 2 Fragile to all Parts.

priorities.1.text: Main-body HP cannot fall below 1 during the first 2 turns. If it survives, continue through the event checks and the next turn; this does not mean your damage is insufficient.

priorities.2.text: In longer fights, watch for “Shared Pain” on the 5-turn cycle. Stagger or destroy either Stem to stop it. Removed Stems cannot be attacked further.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Its HP stops at 1 and it will not die

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: The Canto I version cannot die during the first 2 turns. Continue normal attacks and event checks, then defeat it afterward.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: The Fruit normally regenerates after 1 turn. Deal damage while all Parts have Fragile. After it regenerates, weaken it and pass the resulting check to stop further regeneration.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: I cannot target a Stem after destroying it

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Stems are removable Parts. Destroying one makes it untargetable and stops its actions. Reassign attacks to the remaining Parts.

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: “Shared Pain” is used when both Stems remain. When its warning appears, Stagger or destroy either Stem to stop it. If you cannot do so in time, Clash with a strong skill.

units.0.notes.0.text: Can still be attacked after destruction. Destruction cancels the Fruit's actions, and it does not act while broken.

units.0.notes.1.text: Normally regenerates after 1 turn. Passing the check against the regenerated Fruit prevents further regeneration.

units.1.notes.0.text: Removable. Destruction cancels actions and destroys its slots. Cannot be attacked after destruction.

units.1.notes.1.text: Weak to Slash and resistant to Pierce. Stopping either Stem prevents “Shared Pain”.

units.2.notes.0.text: Removable. Unlike the Right Stem, it has no normal Stagger Threshold.

units.2.notes.1.text: Destruction cancels actions and destroys its slots. Cannot be attacked after destruction.

units.3.notes.0.text: Can still be attacked after destruction, but stops acting. Its slot weight is 2.

units.3.notes.1.text: Destroying the Roots or passing the check to dig them up stops the Bind inflicted each turn.

phases.0.title.text: Take necessary Clashes and break the Fruit with spare attacks

phases.0.steps.0.text: In Focused Encounters, choose targets manually. First Clash against incoming Stem and Root attacks, then focus remaining attacks on the Fruit.

phases.0.steps.1.text: The Fruit is weak to Blunt and has 21 Part HP. Destroying it grants 2 Fragile to all Parts, creating an opening to damage the main body. Stems and Roots are weak to Slash, so their physical weaknesses differ from the Fruit's.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Main-body HP cannot fall below 1 during the first 2 turns. Even with sufficient damage, the fight cannot end during this period; check remaining attacks and events.

phases.1.timing.text: Check at the end of turn 2

phases.1.title.text: Pass the Roots check to stop the recurring Bind

phases.1.steps.0.text: Wrath is favored in the check to dig up the Roots. Success removes Entangling Roots and stops the 1 Bind inflicted every turn.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Failure is not an immediate defeat: destroying the Roots also stops the effect. The required check value is listed as 4 (6 in parentheses), so use the success prediction shown in battle to choose a Sinner.

phases.2.title.text: Stop either Stem to prevent the area attack

phases.2.steps.0.text: If both Stems remain, one uses “Shared Pain” with 5 Attack Weight on a 5-turn cycle. Watch for the gathering-light warning and check the skill name.

phases.2.steps.1.text: The Right Stem has a Stagger Threshold at 40% HP. Stagger or destroy either Stem, or defeat the main body first. The Left Stem has no Stagger Threshold, so handle them differently.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Removed Stems cannot be attacked and no longer act. Removing them also reduces the Roots' bonuses based on remaining Stems; reassign attacks to the remaining Parts.

phases.3.timing.text: Regenerated Fruit check / finishing the fight

phases.3.title.text: Use the chance to stop regeneration and exploit Fragile

phases.3.steps.0.text: The Fruit normally returns 1 turn after destruction. Weakening the regenerated Fruit triggers a warning for the next check. Its exact HP requirement is unconfirmed, so watch for the warning.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Passing the Pride-favored check destroys the Fruit and Staggers the main body. The Fruit will no longer regenerate. The required value is listed as 5 (7 in parentheses), so choose a Sinner using the current prediction.

phases.3.steps.2.text: You can also defeat the main body before that check appears, once the first 2 turns have passed. Exploit Fragile from breaking the Fruit rather than waiting unnecessarily for an event.

skills.0.response.text: The Stems' normal attack. Clash with a skill that can win while directing spare attacks to the Fruit. Removing a Stem stops attacks from that Stem.

skills.1.response.text: The Stems' normal attack. Clash with a skill that can win while directing spare attacks to the Fruit. Removing a Stem stops attacks from that Stem.

skills.2.response.text: Has 1 Coin, but its unmodified maximum Power is 9. Check the current Clash prediction rather than assuming it matches “Distrust”. A removed Stem cannot be attacked further.

skills.3.response.text: Has 1 Coin, but its unmodified maximum Power is 9. Check the current Clash prediction rather than assuming it matches “Distrust”. A removed Stem cannot be attacked further.

skills.4.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.

skills.4.response.text: A Heads hit increases Bleed Count by 3. Prevent it by winning the Clash. Remaining Stems also increase the Roots' Attack Power, so track which Stems are still active.

skills.5.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.

skills.5.response.text: An area attack with 5 Attack Weight. Used on the 5-turn cycle if both Stems remain; when warned, Stagger or destroy either Stem, or defeat the main body before it activates.

skills.6.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.

skills.6.response.text: An area attack with 5 Attack Weight. Used on the 5-turn cycle if both Stems remain; when warned, Stagger or destroy either Stem, or defeat the main body before it activates.

skills.7.response.text: The Fruit's Guard skill. Take necessary Clashes against Stem and Root attacks, then focus spare attacks on the Fruit. Breaking it grants 2 Fragile to all Parts.

passives.0.effect.text: All Parts gain 2 Fragile. Destroyed Fruit regenerates after 1 turn.

passives.0.response.text: Break the Fruit to increase damage against all Parts. It returns until the check to stop regeneration succeeds.

passives.1.condition.text: At Turn Start, while the Roots are not destroyed

passives.1.response.text: Sinners become slower each turn. Stop it by destroying the Roots or passing the turn 2 check.

passives.2.effect.text: The Roots gain 2 Attack Power Up for each undestroyed arm.

passives.2.response.text: Breaking Stems suppresses both the area attack and the Roots' bonuses. Do not judge Root skills solely by their unmodified Power.

mechanics.0.name.text: Death prevention for the first 2 turns

mechanics.0.effect.text: For the first 2 turns of combat, the Canto I version cannot fall below 1 HP or die.

mechanics.0.response.text: Stopping at 1 HP does not mean the strategy failed. Continue the necessary Clashes and events.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Destruction cancels its actions, and it does not act while broken. Normally regenerates after 1 turn. Passing the Fruit check prevents further regeneration and Staggers the main body.

mechanics.1.response.text: Exploit the Fragile applied across all Parts when it breaks. Do not assume an unconfirmed HP requirement for the event after regeneration.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Destruction cancels actions and destroys slots. Cannot be attacked afterward. “Shared Pain” is used only when both Stems remain.

mechanics.2.response.text: Stopping either Stem prevents the area attack. After destruction, move attacks to the remaining Parts.

warnings.0.text: The main body cannot die during the first 2 turns. Stopping at 1 HP does not indicate insufficient damage.

warnings.1.text: The Right Stem has a Stagger Threshold at 40% HP; the Left Stem has none.

warnings.2.text: Fruit and Roots can still be attacked after destruction; removed Stems cannot. Check each Part's behavior.

warnings.3.text: The HP requirement for the check that stops Fruit regeneration is unconfirmed. Do not assume it is half HP or less.

warnings.4.text: An On Heads Hit effect does not activate on every hit.

preparation.0.text: Deploy 5 Sinners. Use the dungeon's recommended Lv. 7 as a guide and prepare a core team that can win Clashes.

preparation.1.text: Blunt is effective against the Fruit; Slash against Stems and Roots. Wrath and Pride deal good damage and are useful for the Roots and Fruit checks.

roles.0.reason.text: Stop attacks while suppressing the area attack and Root bonuses through Right Stem Stagger or Stem removal.

roles.1.reason.text: Use spare actions to break the Fruit and apply Fragile across all Parts.

roles.2.reason.text: Aim to stop Bind from the Roots and regeneration from the Fruit. Choose using the prediction on the event screen.
